description: Robots developed by teams from around the world are competing in events including boxing and hand dexterity challenges at the World Humanoid Robot Games in Beijing. These complex tests are helping developers identify weaknesses and fine-tune products, as investors watch for the next turning point in the physical AI industry.
classificationReason: Reports humanoid robots competing in boxing and dexterity events as tests for AI applications and product development.
qualityReason: Focused news report with clear industry relevance, but limited technical depth in the supplied metadata.
